sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-QUASAR-NVFP4: Text-to-Text model - aimodels.fyi
sources.snippet: Model Overview Overview Qwen3.8-27B-QUASAR-NVFP4 is a 4-bit NVFP4 quantized version of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, produced by QUASAR-QAT with QUASAR quantization-aware training. It is a text-to-text checkpoint with an image-text-to-text pipeline tag, and it runs through the transformers ecosystem with vLLM deployment support.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B-QUASAR-NVFP4 — AI Model Details | Applied
sources.snippet: Model Description QUASAR-QAT/Qwen3.8-27B-QUASAR-NVFP4 is a 4-bit NVFP4 version of Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, produced with QUASAR, a quantization-aware training (QAT) method. Use it exactly as you would a post-training-quantized (PTQ) build of Qwen3.8-27B: it is a drop-in, lower-precision replacement for the original model, not a fine-tune.
